key.name: pinned-apps
key.description: Pinned apps inside the folder, items are {'id': 'x.desktop'}

key.name: dev-mode
key.summary: Enable the in-process D-Bus Dev interface (headless testing only)

key.name: multi-monitor
key.summary: Show a button on every monitor
key.description: Show a menu button on every monitor panel (Dash to Panel / App Icons Taskbar)

key.name: hide-activities-button
key.description: Hide the Activities button in the top panel (previous visibility is restored)

key.name: activate-on-launch
key.summary: Switch to an open window when launching
key.description: Activate an existing window instead of opening a new one when launching an app

key.name: keep-open-on-ctrl-click
key.summary: Keep the menu open on Ctrl+click
key.description: Keep the menu open when activating an item with Ctrl held

key.name: super-key-toggle
key.description: Super key toggles the menu (intercepted in memory only; mutter overlay-key is never written)

key.name: spawn-hotkey
key.description: Custom accelerator(s) that toggle the menu, e.g. ["<Super>space"]; empty = off

key.name: runner-hotkey
key.description: Accelerator(s) that toggle the standalone runner (a search-only popup, independent of the panel button), e.g. ["<Alt>space"]; empty = off. The D-Bus method ToggleRunner does the same

key.name: runner-position
key.description: Top: at the top of the work area of the monitor under the pointer. Centered: vertically centred on it

key.name: runner-menu-height
key.description: The runner grows with its results up to this height; Centered is centred on it

key.name: runner-default-view
key.summary: What the runner shows before anything is typed
key.description: Default: nothing (just the search box). Pinned_Apps / Frequent_Apps: that list of apps

key.name: position-in-panel
key.summary: Position of the menu button in the panel

key.name: menu-button-position-offset
key.description: Number of panel items to skip from the chosen edge

key.name: menu-button-text
key.summary: Label text when the appearance includes text

key.name: menu-button-icon
key.description: Button icon: bundled file name (data/icons), absolute path, or icon name

key.name: menu-button-padding
key.description: Button horizontal padding in px (-1 = theme default)

key.name: pinned-apps-display
key.description: Show pinned apps and folders as a list (ArcMenu style) or as an icon grid

key.name: pinned-item-size
key.description: Size of the pinned apps and folders (and the contents of an open folder): Compact (40 px list rows), Comfortable (48 px) or Large (56 px); the grid tiles scale the same way. The whole row or tile, including the space between items, is clickable

key.name: context-menu-items
key.default: [ {'id': 'org.gnome.Extensions.desktop'}, {'id': 'Spawn_Settings', 'name': 'Spawn Settings', 'icon': 'Spawn_SpawnIcon'}, {'id': 'Spawn_PanelExtensionSettings', 'name': 'Panel Extension Settings', 'icon': 'application-x-addon-symbolic'}, {'id': 'Spawn_Separator', 'name': 'Separator', 'icon': 'list-remove-symbolic'}, {'id': 'Spawn_PowerOptions', 'name': 'Power Options', 'icon': 'system-shutdown-symbolic'}, {'id': 'Spawn_ActivitiesOverview', 'name': 'Activities Overview', 'icon': 'view-fullscreen-symbolic'}, {'id': 'Spawn_ShowDesktop', 'name': 'Show Desktop', 'icon': 'computer-symbolic'} ]
key.description: Items of the menu shown on the panel button's context-menu click (apps, Spawn_* actions, separators)

key.name: default-menu-view
key.summary: View shown when the menu opens

key.name: all-apps-button-action
key.summary: What the All Apps button shows

key.name: max-frequent-apps
key.summary: Max apps in the Frequent view / Pinned_And_Frequent_Apps

key.name: menu-width-adjustment
key.summary: Extra width added to the menu in px

key.name: vert-separator
key.summary: Draw a vertical separator between the panes

key.name: multi-lined-labels
key.summary: Allow app labels to wrap onto several lines in the grid

key.name: scrollview-fade-effect
key.summary: Fade effect at the edges of scroll views

key.name: show-user-avatar
key.summary: Show the user avatar card in the right pane

key.name: icon-size-apps
key.summary: Icon size of application items (-1 = default)

key.name: icon-size-shortcuts
key.summary: Icon size of shortcut items (-1 = default, 0 = hidden)

key.name: icon-size-categories
key.summary: Icon size of category items (-1 = default, 0 = hidden)

key.name: icon-size-buttons
key.summary: Icon size of button items (-1 = default)

key.name: icon-size-misc
key.summary: Icon size of the search box icons and the Back / All Apps buttons (-1 = default)

key.name: icon-size-grid
key.description: Icon size of pinned-app grid tiles (keys width/height/size, -1 = default)

key.name: pinned-apps
key.description: Pinned apps and folders; folder entries are {id: <uuid>, name, isFolder: "true"} with contents in folders/<uuid>/

key.name: directory-shortcuts
key.description: Directory shortcuts in the right pane (Spawn_* ids or custom {id: path, name, icon})

key.name: application-shortcuts
key.description: Application shortcuts in the right pane (Spawn_* ids, .desktop ids, separators)

key.name: power-options
key.default: [(0, true), (1, true), (2, true), (3, true), (4, false), (5, false), (6, false), (7, false), (8, false)]
key.description: Power buttons: (id, enabled); ids 0 LogOut 1 Lock 2 Restart 3 PowerOff 4 Suspend 5 HybridSleep 6 Hibernate 7 SwitchUser 8 RestartToFirmwareSetup (off by default)

key.name: arcmenu-extra-categories-links
key.description: Quick links on the start view: (id, enabled), in display order; ids 0 Favourites (GNOME favourites) 1 Frequent 2 All apps 3 Pinned 4 Recent files. The link of the current start view is never shown

key.name: arcmenu-extra-categories-links-location
key.summary: Where the category quick links are shown
key.description: Top: above the list; Bottom: below it, above the Back / All Apps button

key.name: show-external-devices
key.summary: Show external devices and network locations
key.description: Mounted drives and network locations in the right pane, with an eject / unmount button

key.name: show-bookmarks
key.description: The bookmarks of ~/.config/gtk-3.0/bookmarks (the Files sidebar) in the right pane

key.name: search-hidden
key.summary: Hide the search entry until the user types

key.name: hidden-apps
key.description: Desktop ids ("org.gnome.Nautilus.desktop") of apps removed from All Apps, the categories and Frequent. Pinned apps stay pinned

key.name: search-hidden-apps
key.description: Hidden apps still appear in search results while this is on

key.name: show-new-apps-badge
key.summary: Mark recently installed apps as New
key.description: A small "New" badge on apps first seen in the last three days, cleared when the app is launched

key.name: known-apps
key.description: Every installed desktop id Spawn has seen. Empty on first run, when it is filled with the apps installed at that moment so nothing is New

key.name: new-apps
key.description: Desktop id mapped to the unix time Spawn first saw the app; entries go after three days, when the app is launched or when it is uninstalled

key.name: search-entry-location
key.summary: Search entry position (top or bottom of the left pane)
key.description: Auto puts the search entry nearest the panel the menu opens from

key.name: show-search-result-details
key.summary: Show the description line of search results

key.name: search-provider-shell
key.description: Include GNOME Shell search providers (e.g. Calculator, Characters)

key.name: show-hidden-recent-files
key.summary: Show hidden files in recent-file results

key.name: apps-show-extra-details
key.summary: Larger icon and extra detail for app results

key.name: apps-show-generic-names
key.summary: Show GenericName instead of Name where available

key.name: search-entry-border-radius
key.description: Search entry border radius: (enabled, px)

key.name: override-menu-theme
key.description: Use the custom colours below instead of the shell theme and GNOME accent

key.name: menu-button-fg-color
key.description: Panel button foreground: (enabled, colour)

key.name: menu-button-bg-color
key.description: Panel button background: (enabled, colour)

key.name: menu-button-border-radius
key.description: Panel button border radius: (enabled, px)

key.name: menu-button-border-width
key.description: Panel button border width: (enabled, px)

key.name: menu-button-border-color
key.description: Panel button border colour: (enabled, colour)

key.name: menu-button-hover-bg-color
key.description: Panel button hover background: (enabled, colour)

key.name: menu-button-hover-fg-color
key.description: Panel button hover foreground: (enabled, colour)

key.name: menu-button-active-bg-color
key.description: Panel button active background: (enabled, colour)

key.name: menu-button-active-fg-color
key.description: Panel button active foreground: (enabled, colour)

key.name: menu-themes
key.description: Saved colour themes. Applying one writes the menu colour keys; this list itself is never changed by that

key.name: menu-position-alignment
key.summary: Menu alignment under a centred button
key.description: 0 = the menu extends to the left of the button, 50 = centred on it, 100 = to the right. Only used while the button is centred in the panel

key.name: menu-arrow-rise
key.description: Menu distance from the panel (the arrow rise of the popup): (enabled, px, 0 to 50; the shell theme's own rise is about 4)

key.name: runner-font-size
key.description: Font size of the standalone runner in pt; 0 uses the menu font

key.name: prefs-visible-page
key.summary: Preferences page that was last open

key.name: migration-done
key.description: ArcMenu import has been performed (prefs shows a notice instead of the prompt)
